نستقصي (form X)
# نَسْتَقْصِي (nastaqṣī) /nas.taq.sˤiː/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَقْصَى (istaqṣā)
# نَسْتَقْصِيَ (nastaqṣiya) /nas.taq.sˤi.ja/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَقْصَى (istaqṣā)
